description: Manages various types of reference data and lookup values used across the system, such as currencies, countries, application types, and basic lists of partners, contacts, and users.

endpoints.name: GetCurrencies
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all available currencies.
example_uses: How can I get a list of all supported currencies?
Show me the currency codes.
I need to see all available currencies for a dropdown.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to retrieve a comprehensive list of all currencies supported by the system, typically for populating dropdowns or reference lists.

endpoints.name: GetEligibleEntities
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of entities that are eligible for certain operations or classifications.
example_uses: What are the eligible entities?
List all entities that qualify.
I need to see the list of eligible entities.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch a list of entities that meet specific eligibility criteria within the system, useful for filtering or validation purposes.

endpoints.name: GetCountries
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all countries.
example_uses: Can I get a list of all countries?
Show me the country codes and names.
I need a list of countries for a form.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a complete list of countries, typically for geographical selection in forms or reports.

endpoints.name: GetApplicationTypes
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all defined application types.
example_uses: What are the different application types?
List all available application categories.
I need to know the types of applications supported.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch a list of predefined application types, useful for categorizing or filtering applications.

endpoints.name: GetPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves a basic list of all registered partners. Note: For detailed partner information or advanced search capabilities, refer to the dedicated Partner entity.
example_uses: Can I get a list of all partners?
Show me the names of all partners.
I need a quick list of partners.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a basic, unfiltered list of all partners. This is suitable for simple lookups or populating dropdowns where full partner details are not immediately required.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationUnits
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all organizational units within the system.
example_uses: What are the organizational units?
List all departments or divisions.
I need to see the organizational structure.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch a list of all organizational units, useful for assigning responsibilities or structuring data by department.

endpoints.name: GetLiaisonOffices
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all liaison offices.
example_uses: What are the liaison offices?
List all regional offices.
I need to see the contact points for liaison.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a list of all liaison offices, typically for contact information or regional assignments.

endpoints.name: GetContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a basic list of all contacts. Note: For detailed contact information or advanced search capabilities, refer to the dedicated Contact entity.
example_uses: Can I get a list of all contacts?
Show me the names of all contacts.
I need a quick list of contacts.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a basic, unfiltered list of all contacts. This is suitable for simple lookups or populating dropdowns where full contact details are not immediately required.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all registered users.
example_uses: Can I get a list of all users?
Show me the names of all system users.
I need a quick list of users.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a basic, unfiltered list of all users registered in the system, suitable for simple lookups or populating dropdowns.

endpoints.name: GetGeminiModels
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of available Gemini AI models.
example_uses: What Gemini models are available?
List all supported AI models.
I need to know which Gemini models I can use.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch a list of available Gemini AI models, typically for configuration or selection in AI-powered features.
